fields.label: Backend Service
fields.help: A reference to the BackendService resource.

fields.label: Certificate Map
fields.help: A reference to the CertificateMap resource uri that identifies a certificate map associated with the given target proxy.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Proxy Header
fields.help: Specifies the type of proxy header to append before sending data to the backend.

fields.label: SSL Certificates
fields.help: A list of SslCertificate resources that are used to authenticate connections between users and the load balancer.

fields.label: SSL Policy
fields.help: A reference to the SslPolicy resource that will be associated with the TargetSslProxy resource.
